recipes.name: Chickpea & Rice Tortilla Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the tomatoes and burrito spice mix. Cook for another 2 minutes, stirring often. Then add in the remaining soup ingredients.
Bring the soup to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the rice is fully cooked.
Line two baking trays and preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*.
Cut each tortilla into 12 pieces and transfer the pieces to a large bowl. Pour the oil, salt, and pepper over the tortillas. Toss and massage with your hands to coat.
Lay the pieces in a single layer over the baking trays*.

Bake in the oven on the middle and lowest rack for 3 to 4 minutes. Then flip the tortillas over and return to the oven to bake for another 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the oven when the edges of the chips are toasted. Keep an eye on them during baking because they can easily over toast.
When the soup is done, serve with the baked tortilla chips. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Our large tortillas measure about 10 inches (25 cm) in diameter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** Crowding all the pitas onto one tray can cause the chips to steam rather than roast, which might prevent them from getting crispy.
Storage The soup can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. The tortilla chips can be stored in a container on the counter for up to 2 days.
